# Lean ERP

Follow root AGENTS.md and docs/CORE_ERP_SCOPE.md. The current system has the core/accounts/business apps; its navigation entries and fixed role codes are listed in AGENTS.md (one account may hold several roles; permissions are the union). Role duties and boundaries are maintained only in docs/ROLE_RESPONSIBILITIES.md. docs/archive/ is historical and not the current module or deployment list. Use docs/LEAN_REBUILD_CONTRACT.md for API changes.
